nonBlockingIssues.description: The new regression still relies on ambient repo-root dotenv state to exercise the root-env-fallback disable path, so that hardening behavior is not yet covered with fully deterministic fallback contents.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented the auth-broker test-isolation helper and `HACK_AUTH_BROKER_DISABLE_ROOT_ENV_FALLBACK` hermetic-test flag in `.factory/library/environment.md`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Allow baseline-hardening features to continue after capturing an expected failing baseline, as long as the worker records the failing evidence before fixing it.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `validation-harness-hardening` review found the worker had to deviate from the generic baseline-validation rule because the feature itself was assigned to fix the known red baseline.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document a verification fallback for GitHub auth-path changes when the current repo config does not enable the GitHub extension, so workers can still produce deterministic proof without pretending the repo-bound CLI exercised the changed path.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `provider-unattended-auth-paths` review found this repo only enables Linear in `.hack/hack.config.json`, so the worker had to use a direct resolver smoke instead of the nominal repo-bound GitHub status flow.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Either document a safe repo-bound Linear failure-injection / rerun-dedupe verification path or explicitly allow deterministic regression tests when no safe manual hook exists.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `linear-sync-failure-order-and-idempotency` review found the mission contract expects forced local-sync failure and repeated-sync manual evidence, but `.factory/services.yaml` only documents `linear_status` and `repo_linear_smoke` commands.
